comment: fixed boxes inside an overflow: hidden scroller (and a positioned, clipping parent): the viewport is their containing block, the scroller neither clips them nor moves them when it scrolls. Tolerance: with 4x MSAA, Mesa's llvmpipe and lavapipe (the test image's GL and Vulkan drivers) let the samples of the pixel row above and the column left of a scissor rectangle through: content scrolled past the top edge of a clipping box shows as a half-covered line 1 px above it (measured: RmlUi's clip region and the target scissor are exact, the line goes away without MSAA; ZZ probe in the p3-layout report). The cluster limit covers that one line; the boxes keep their 1 px tolerance
